name: nonApi_updateRunCountsForEventUsers
description: Recalculates run-count statistics for every non-anonymous hasher who has a HasherEventMap row for @eventId. The same five-stage pipeline as nonApi_updateRunCountsForAllUsers, with #affected scoped to this event's attendees instead of a datetime watermark: (1) insert missing HasherKennelMap rows for kennels those users have attended; (2) recompute the six HEM count columns (TotalRuns, TotalHaring, TotalRunsThisKennel, TotalHaringThisKennel, YtdTotalRunsThisKennel, YtdHaringThisKennel) with window functions over qualifying runs (attended, not virgin/visitor, counted, visible, not removed, starting within the next 6 h or earlier); (3) NULL the counts on rows that no longer qualify; (4) recompute the HKM summary counters (HcTotalRunCount, HcHaringCount, YtdTotalRunCount, YtdHaringCount, DateOfLastRun; CurrentHaringCount / CurrentPackRunCount / HistoricalPackRunCount forced to 0); (5) recompute the HKM rolling-year counts. Every stage writes only rows whose values change. Called by addEditEvent AFTER nonApi_updateRunNumbers so an event edit refreshes its attendees' counts immediately rather than at the nightly sweep (nonApi_updateRunNumbers touches only HC.Event, so a watermark-based recompute would miss them). Known, accepted limitation: when the edit cascades a renumbering onto LATER runs, those runs' attendees are not in #affected and stay stale until the 03:10 UTC sweep. No TRY/CATCH by design — it runs inside the caller's transaction and any error propagates to the caller's CATCH. Internal; no auth. Returns nothing. Writes one LOG.GeneralLog row ('RUN COUNTS', 'Updated run counts for event users') per call. Since 2026-10-13 Stage 5 uses the 365-days-back-from-today bucket and the LEFT JOIN clearing shape of nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser (scoped to the run's attendees); until then it kept the old six-month-anchored 182-day bucket, which dropped runs from the last day or two whenever a run was saved.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The event whose attendees' counts to recompute. NULL or unknown ⇒ #affected empty ⇒ no-op (no log row).

sideEffects: Stage 1: INSERTs HC.HasherKennelMap rows (all counters 0, permissions 0, DiscountDescription '') for affected users who attended a kennel without an HKM row.

Stage 2: UPDATEs HC.HasherEventMap TotalRuns, TotalHaring, TotalRunsThisKennel, TotalHaringThisKennel, YtdTotalRunsThisKennel, YtdHaringThisKennel, updatedAt for affected users' qualifying rows whose values changed.

Stage 3: NULLs the same six columns (and stamps updatedAt) on affected users' rows that no longer qualify (AttendenceState < 20, virgin/visitor, missing/uncounted/hidden/removed event, or start more than 6 h in the future) and still hold a value.

Stage 4: UPDATEs HC.HasherKennelMap HcTotalRunCount, HcHaringCount, YtdTotalRunCount, YtdHaringCount, DateOfLastRun, zeroes CurrentHaringCount / CurrentPackRunCount / HistoricalPackRunCount, stamps updatedAt — where any value changed.

Stage 5: UPDATEs HC.HasherKennelMap RollingYearTotalRunCount, RollingYearHaringCount, updatedAt where changed — only for (user, kennel) pairs with at least one qualifying run (INNER JOIN; see code smells).
Inserts one LOG.GeneralLog row (LogSource 'RUN COUNTS', Timestamp from the table default). Creates and drops #affected.

codeSmells.issue: No TRY/CATCH (by design) — an error is attributed to the caller
codeSmells.detail: Documented in the header (lines 23–25): it runs inside addEditEvent's transaction and the caller's CATCH logs the failure under the caller's name. Noted here because CLAUDE.md asks for the wrapper on every SP; the design reason is real.

@eventId has no SQL default. Called only by EXEC from hcapp_/hcportal_ addEditEvent, which always pass it. A call that omits one fails before the body runs — no HC.ErrorLog row, no graceful check (CLAUDE.md 'SP parameter with NO default').

codeSmells.issue: Unused INNER JOINs to HC.Kennel, HC.City and DomainValues.Timezone act as a filter
codeSmells.detail: Stages 2 and 5 (lines 143–145, 280–282) join Kennel → City → Timezone but never read tz; the joins only drop runs of a kennel whose city has no timezone row. Same shape in the two sibling SPs (inherited from HC5.fn_GetRunCounts); listed so the three are changed together if it is ever removed.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
